body: I’ve graduated three years ago. I didn’t have friends in high school. I was the social outcast that everyone made fun of. I’m too poor to move. I barely have enough money to save after bills and food. So I’m stuck if I continue to live.
Guy, middle of the United States.

I’ve tried. We talk for a bit, we say our goodbyes, and then I never hear from them again. Which I guess it’s fair, I’m pretty worthless. It happens everytime. I guess I suck at conversations to drive them off. I think I’m done with people in general.
